x-bump-note: 1.0.0 initial. RE-VENDOR: claude-klabauter must vendor this schema (coordinator_core/frontmatter/schemas/chatty-roster.schema.json) before the roster emitter or the SendMessage guard reads <run-dir>/roster.json.
description: Roster of an opt-in chatty workflow run, written to <run-dir>/roster.json. Absence of the file means the run is not chatty and the guard is a no-op. Read-side rule not expressible in JSON Schema: members[].nonce values must be unique within the roster (a reader must reject duplicates). The counters object has exactly one writer, the SendMessage guard; no other agent may write it, since concurrent writers would race the file.

overseer_role.description: Role of the only member allowed to send to main. Must name a member role (read-side rule).

nonce.description: Per-member token placed in the brief; uniqueness across members is a read-side rule.

agent_id.description: Null until the member registers by resolving its nonce.

counters.description: Written only by the SendMessage guard.

per_role.description: Per-role sent count, checked against caps.agent_messages_max.
